name: NSF graduate science fellowships
description: Federal fellowships supported selected individuals pursuing advanced scientific study.

date.basis: Date of the documented episode, not a universal origin.

events.statement: The NSF reported awarding 624 graduate and postdoctoral fellowships for 1952–53 from approximately 3,000 applicants.
events.scope: 1952 fellowship cohort, distinct from research-project grants.

evidence.locator: pp. 21–24, scientific manpower and fellowship program
evidence.supports: Reports April 1952 awards, applicant count and terms.

earliest_record.rationale: Earliest documented episode in this scoped record, not a global origin.

caveats: The report states awards and stipend terms, not actual disbursement or equal access. Applicants underwent tests, academic review and recommendations; 55 of the 624 awards were postdoctoral.

research.note: Initial source pass. Independent review inspected the 1952 NSF report pp. 21–24: 624 awards comprised 569 predoctoral and 55 postdoctoral, selected from about 3,000 applicants; changed the denominator label from applications to applicants.

measures.subject: 1952 NSF fellowship cohort
measures.conditions: 569 predoctoral and 55 postdoctoral awards; not necessarily acceptances or payments.

evidence.supports: Reports April 1952 awards, applicant count and terms.

measures.conditions: Approximately 3,000 applicants; approximate count, not an exact success-rate denominator.
